payload.problem: The approved opportunity requires use of a human Reddit account and disclosure of account/profile information in an external application. Whether Patrick is willing to use an eligible account for this purpose is his privacy/property/willingness decision.
payload.recommendation: Authorize use of a qualifying Reddit account (at least two months old under the published subreddit rule) for a single transparent application. If authorized, Vera Works will first prepare a truthful application package and original writing sample; Patrick will then receive a bounded PATRICK_ACTION_REQUIRED request to manually send the message. The application will disclose AI-assisted Vera Works production and will ask the buyer to confirm that arrangement before substantive work.
alternatives: Decline use of a Reddit account and return the first-dollar assignment to sourcing.
Authorize a different zero-upfront channel if Patrick prefers not to use Reddit.
Do nothing; no application will be sent and no external effect will occur.
consequences: Authorization creates no spend or contract by itself, but it permits preparation of a customer-facing application for Patrick to send manually.
The buyer may reject AI-assisted production or the application.
The poster and payment terms are not independently verified, so acceptance of any work remains separately gated after due diligence.
Declining has no financial cost; it only sends the workflow back to sourcing.
payload.inaction_effect: The first-dollar assignment remains held. No Reddit message, account action, customer communication, spend, or contract occurs.
payload.completion_evidence_requested: Patrick records AUTHORIZE or DECLINE. If AUTHORIZE, identify only whether an account meeting the subreddit age rule is available; no password, credential, or private account identifier belongs in GitHub.
